_tooltips.id: Unique within your organization, lower-case, e.g. order-discussion. Conversations refer to the chat by it, so avoid changing it later.
_tooltips.name: The chat's name as people see it, e.g. Order discussion.
_tooltips.description: A note on what the chat is for; users do not see it.
_tooltips.subjectType: What the chat is about. Only ENTITY — a record of an entity type — exists today.
_tooltips.subjectDefinition: The entity type whose records get the chat, e.g. order. It has to exist when the chat is released.
_tooltips.multiplicity: SINGLE: one conversation per record. MANY: any number of titled topics per record.
_tooltips.lifecycle: AUTO_CREATE: the conversation starts with its record. ON_DEMAND: it starts when somebody with a create role opens it. STATE_BOUND: on demand, and writable only in the states listed below.
_tooltips.writableStates: STATE_BOUND only: the states of the record in which the conversation accepts messages. The record's entity type needs a state machine with these states.
_tooltips.readRoles: Roles that may read the conversation. Empty: every member of the organization.
_tooltips.writeRoles: Roles that may post. Empty: every member who can read.
_tooltips.createRoles: Roles that may start a conversation or topic. Empty: every member who can write.
_tooltips.includeSubjectOwner: Whether the person who owns the record may take part regardless of the roles above.
_tooltips.retentionDays: Nach wie vielen Tagen ohne neue Nachricht ein Gespräch dieses Chats samt Nachrichten endgültig gelöscht wird. Leer: der Standardwert der Installation, sonst für immer aufbewahrt. Gilt für die freigegebene Definition.
_tooltips.releaseState: Whether the running application uses this definition as it stands: NEW was never released, CHANGED differs from the release, RELEASED is what the application uses. Set by the system.
